course_name_original: Fluid Mechanics and Hydraulic Machinery - Mecanica fluidelor şi maşini hidraulice

learning_outcomes.text: Systematic acquisition by students of basic knowledge in the field of the life cycle of complex process engineering systems, with reference to the needs for designing and integrating processes and their environmental implications.
Familiarization with the terminology, methods, and typical notions specific to the component elements, structuring, functioning, calculation, and conditions of models.
Acquisition of methods for analyzing and optimizing industrial manufacturing processes.
Evaluation of projects by applying life cycle precepts.

syllabus_topics: Concept of systems engineering and process engineering. Typology of process systems.
Logical and deductive presentation, explanation, debate, problematization, group work methods, study of curricular documents and bibliography, heuristic methods.
Analysis methods in process systems engineering.
Models and meta-models in process systems engineering.
Analysis and evaluation of processes in process systems engineering.
Specific activities in process systems engineering.
Product life cycle and associated costs.
Structural-functional analysis of numerically controlled modular technological equipment.
Group work methods, case study, experiments, situation simulation, explanation, demonstration, algorithmization, problematization.
CAD-CAM methods for designing 3-axis milling processes.
Establishing cutting regime parameters for milling and their influence on the roughness of machined surfaces.
Analysis of workpiece installation devices. Determining clamping forces developed by machine vises.
Comparative study of milling strategies for complex geometric entities.
Assisted technological design of 2½-axis and 4-axis milling processes.
Analysis of computer-assisted ultrasonic welding technologies for plastics and composites.

assessment_methods.method: Understanding and knowledge acquisition (via 3 distributed verifications and written examination)
Ability to use methods (via testing during verifications)
Summative evaluation of applied activities (applied assignment and presentation of laboratory reports, with processing and interpretation of experimental results)

assessment_rules: Minimum performance for passing includes knowledge and application of a design/optimization method for manufacturing processes, evaluation of a project based on the life cycle, and quality evaluation. Verification of these aspects is through applications based on the analysis of stages and results.
